title: 实验 5-18 · 高边还是低边：3.3 V 引脚为什么推不动“上面”的 NPN
summary: 同一块 ESP32 上并排两个 5 V 继电器：一个用 NPN 放在负载上面（高边、射极跟随），一个放在负载下面（低边）。测两种接法下线圈拿到的电压和电流，看高边为什么吸不上。
concepts: 高边 / 低边开关 high-side / low-side switch
放大区 vs 饱和区 active vs saturation
继电器吸合电流 relay pull-in current
description: **目标**：用 NPN 三极管从 3.3 V 的 GPIO 驱动 5 V 继电器，比较把三极管放在负载上面（高边）和下面（低边）两种接法，看为什么高边吸不上、低边可以。
**电路**：ESP32 插在 b1，USB 供电。上方 tp 轨接 **5V 引脚**（h19 → tp19），tn 轨接 GND（a1 → tn1）。两个继电器（SRD-05VDC，线圈 70 Ω，≥ 53 mA 吸合）、两个 NPN（2N2222，β = 150）、两个 1 kΩ 基极电阻、两个续流二极管：
- **高边（high-side）K1**：输出 GPIO（参考答案 GPIO18）→ RB1 1 kΩ → Q1 基极；Q1 **集电极接 5V**，**发射极接 K1 线圈 coil1**；K1 coil2 接 GND。D1 反并联在线圈上（色环接发射极一端）。参考答案：K1 在 e20、Q1 在 a20（E B C = 20、21、22 列）。
- **低边（low-side）K2**：另一个输出 GPIO（参考答案 GPIO19）→ RB2 1 kΩ → Q2 基极；**K2 coil1 接 5V**，coil2 接 Q2 **集电极**；Q2 **发射极接 GND**。D2 反并联在线圈上（色环接 5V）。参考答案：K2 在 e25、Q2 在 a26。
**引脚设置**：两个引脚都设成输出；测试会分别打开高边和低边。参考答案默认是高边关、低边开。
- 高边：负载接在发射极上，电路变成了**射极跟随器（共集电极）**，发射极电压 = 基极电压 − 0.65 V，而基极电压最高就是 GPIO 的 3.3 V（还要减去 Ib × RB）。发射极能到多少伏？线圈电流够不够 53 mA？Q1 在哪个工作区，C–E 上剩多少电压？把 5V 换成 12V、或把 β 换成 1000，会好起来吗？
- 低边：发射极接 GND，Ib = (V_GPIO − V_BE) / 1 kΩ，β·Ib 和线圈需要的电流比哪个大？三极管会不会饱和，线圈上有多少伏？
- 两种接法下**线圈电流**和继电器是否吸合；
- 三极管的**工作区**（右侧属性面板里显示）：开关必须在饱和区；
- 高边时**发射极电压**：负载上到底能拿到多少电压；
- 换一个 β = 1000 的管子，高边能不能好起来。电路检查通过后，把读数填进下面的「测量」（以你自己的面包板为准）；答完后会显示计算对比。
**那什么时候必须用高边？** 负载必须一端接地的时候：例如给一个传感器模块断电（它的 GND 还和别的信号连在一起）、汽车电路（车身就是地）、LED 共阴的数码管。正确做法：
- **P 沟道 MOSFET**（如 AO3401、IRF9540）放在上面，源极接 5V；栅极由一个**低边 NPN / N-MOS 电平转换**拉到 GND 导通、靠上拉电阻到 5V 关断（3.3 V 引脚直接驱动 P-MOS 的栅极关不断 5 V 的管子）；
- 或者现成的高边开关芯片（BTS / TPS 系列）、继电器模块。
本模拟器暂时没有 PNP 和 P-MOSFET，所以这里只演示 NPN 高边的局限；能用低边就用低边。
**实际项目经验**：
- 单片机直接驱动的开关，默认都用 **低边 N 型**（NPN 或逻辑电平 N-MOS），发射极 / 源极接地。
- 基极电阻按“过驱动 2–10 倍”选：Ib ≥ (2–10) × Ic / β。这里 Ic 是线圈电流（约 4.4 V / 70 Ω），β = 150，Ib 至少零点几毫安；1 kΩ 给的远远够饱和。
- 继电器线圈必须并续流二极管（1N4148 / 1N4007），否则关断时的反向高压会击穿三极管。
- 5 V 继电器从 ESP32 的 5V 引脚取电时注意 USB 预算：每个继电器约 63–72 mA。现成的“继电器模块”通常已经带了三极管、二极管和光耦。
- 用 GPIO18 / 19 这类普通引脚；ESP32 的 GPIO0 / 2 / 5 / 12 / 15 上电时会有短暂的电平或脉冲，继电器可能误动作。
**模型说明**：NPN 是 0.65 V + 20 Ω 的 BE 结 + 恒定 β，饱和 Vce = 0.15 V + 1 Ω × Ic；继电器线圈 70 Ω + 150 mH，53 mA 吸合、7 mA 释放（直流测试里不考虑吸合后的保持电流比吸合电流小）；ESP32 输出级是 25 Ω。

en.title: Experiment 5-18 · High side or low side: why a 3.3 V pin can't drive an NPN "above" the load
en.summary: Two 5 V relays side by side on one ESP32: one NPN above its load (high side, an emitter follower), one below (low side). Measure the coil voltage and current in each and see why the high side cannot pull in.
description: **Goal**: drive a 5 V relay from a 3.3 V GPIO through an NPN transistor, and compare putting the transistor above the load (high side) with putting it below (low side): see why the high side fails to pull in and the low side works.

**Circuit**: an ESP32 at b1 on USB. The top tp rail is the **5V pin** (h19 → tp19), tn is GND (a1 → tn1). Two relays (SRD-05VDC, 70 Ω coil, pull-in ≥ 53 mA), two NPNs (2N2222, β = 150), two 1 kΩ base resistors and two flyback diodes:

- **High side, K1**: an output GPIO (solution: GPIO18) → RB1 1 kΩ → base of Q1; Q1's **collector to 5V**, its **emitter to K1 coil1**; K1 coil2 to GND. D1 reversed across the coil (band at the emitter end). Solution: K1 at e20, Q1 at a20 (E B C = columns 20, 21, 22).

- **Low side, K2**: another output GPIO (solution: GPIO19) → RB2 1 kΩ → base of Q2; **K2 coil1 to 5V**, coil2 to Q2's **collector**; Q2's **emitter to GND**. D2 reversed across the coil (band to 5V). Solution: K2 at e25, Q2 at a26.
**Pin table settings**: both pins are outputs; the tests turn on the high side and the low side in turn. The solution's default is high side off, low side on.
**Predict first**:

- High side: with the load on the emitter the circuit is an **emitter follower (common collector)**: emitter voltage = base voltage − 0.65 V, and the base can be at most the GPIO's 3.3 V (minus Ib × RB). How high can the emitter get? Is the coil current above 53 mA? Which region is Q1 in, and how much voltage is left across C–E? Would a 12 V supply or a β = 1000 transistor help?
- Low side: with the emitter at GND, Ib = (V_GPIO − V_BE) / 1 kΩ. Is β·Ib larger than the current the coil needs? Does the transistor saturate, and how many volts does the coil get?
**Measure**:
- the **coil current** and whether each relay pulls in;
- the transistors' **region**: a switch must be saturated;
- the **emitter voltage** on the high side: how much voltage the load really gets;

- whether a β = 1000 transistor rescues the high side. Once the circuit check passes, type your readings into the Measurements below (whatever your own board shows); the worked comparison appears after you answer.

**So when do you need a high-side switch?** When the load must keep one end at ground: cutting power to a sensor module (its GND is shared with other signals), automotive circuits (the chassis is ground), common-cathode LED displays. The proper way:

- a **P-channel MOSFET** (AO3401, IRF9540) on top with its source at 5V; its gate is pulled to GND to turn on by a **low-side NPN / N-MOS level shifter** and pulled up to 5V to turn off (a 3.3 V pin driving the P-MOS gate directly can't turn off a 5 V switch);
- or a ready-made high-side switch IC (BTS / TPS families) or relay module.
The simulator has no PNP or P-MOSFET yet, so this experiment only shows the NPN high-side limitation; use the low side whenever you can.
**Rule of thumb for real projects**:
- A switch driven straight from an MCU is by default a **low-side N-type** (NPN or logic-level N-MOS) with the emitter / source at ground.

- Size the base resistor for 2–10 × overdrive: Ib ≥ (2–10) × Ic / β. Here Ic is the coil current (about 4.4 V / 70 Ω) and β = 150, so Ib must be a fraction of a milliamp at least; 1 kΩ gives far more — enough to saturate.
- A relay coil always needs a flyback diode (1N4148 / 1N4007), or the turn-off kick breaks down the transistor.
- Powering 5 V relays from the ESP32's 5V pin eats into the USB budget: about 63–72 mA per relay. Ready-made "relay modules" usually already contain the transistor, diode and an optocoupler.
- Use plain pins like GPIO18 / 19; the ESP32's GPIO0 / 2 / 5 / 12 / 15 have brief levels or pulses at boot that can click a relay.

**Model note**: the NPN is a 0.65 V + 20 Ω B–E junction with constant β and saturation Vce = 0.15 V + 1 Ω × Ic; the relay coil is 70 Ω + 150 mH, pulling in at 53 mA and dropping out at 7 mA (the DC tests ignore that the hold current is lower than the pull-in current); the ESP32 output stage is 25 Ω.
compare: **Compare: high side**: V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ **2.41 V** (simulated 2.41 V). The coil only gets 2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ **34 mA**, below the 53 mA pull-in current — **K1 does not pull in**. The remaining 5V − 2.41 V ≈ **2.26 V** sits across C–E: Q1 is in the **active region** and wastes 77 mW.
- A 12 V supply instead of 5V doesn't help: the emitter is still at 2.4 V, there is just more voltage (and heat) across the transistor.

- A β = 1000 transistor doesn't help either: less base current means less drop across RB, so V_E only rises to **2.61 V** (37 mA) — still no pull-in. The limit is not the gain but "the emitter is always 0.65 V below the base".

- With the high side on, the live diagnostics show a warning "K1 coil current too low to pull in: 34 mA" and a note "Q1 is in the active region (not fully on)" — exactly what is wrong with this circuit.

**Compare: low side**: V_BE is always 0.65 V and Ib = (3.23 − 0.70) V / 1 kΩ ≈ **2.5 mA**. β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ the 63 mA the coil needs, so the transistor **saturates** with Vce only **0.21 V**; the coil gets 4.44 V (5V pin 4.65 V − 0.21 V), **63 mA**, and K2 pulls in. The pin only supplies 2.5 mA and the transistor dissipates 15 mW.

measurements.ask: High side on only: Q1's emitter to GND (the voltage the coil gets)
measurements.explain: An emitter follower: V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ 2.41 V. The emitter is always 0.65 V below the base, and the base can't exceed 3.3 V.
2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ 34 mA < 53 mA: K1 does not pull in. The remaining ≈ 2.3 V sits across Q1's C–E; Q1 is in the active region, just getting warm.

measurements.ask: Low side on only: Q2's Vce
measurements.explain: Ib ≈ 2.5 mA, β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA: Q2 saturates, Vce ≈ 0.21 V.
The coil gets 4.65 − 0.21 ≈ 4.44 V, ≈ 63 mA, and K2 pulls in. The pin supplies only 2.5 mA and the transistor dissipates 15 mW.

measurements.ask: Give the high side a β = 1000 transistor (change Q1's β in its properties). Does K1 pull in?
measurements.explain: Ib gets smaller and RB drops less, but V_E only reaches ≈ 2.61 V (37 mA). The limit is not the gain; a 12 V supply wouldn't help either. If you must switch the high side, use a P-channel MOSFET with a level shifter, or a ready-made high-side switch.
choices: no: the emitter is still capped at "base voltage − 0.65 V" and only rises to about 2.6 V
yes: a bigger β means a bigger coil current

hints: High side: collector to 5V, emitter to the relay coil, the coil's other end to GND.
Low side: the coil from 5V to the collector, emitter to GND.
Each coil gets its own reversed diode: band toward the more positive end of the coil.
Each base gets its own 1 kΩ from a different output GPIO.
tests: High side on: K1 does not pull in, Q1 in the active region
Low side on: Q2 saturated, K2 pulls in; little pin current
High side with a β = 1000 transistor: still no pull-in
Both on: only the low-side K2 pulls in

tests.name: 打开高边：K1 吸不上，Q1 在放大区
打开低边：Q2 饱和，K2 吸合；引脚电流很小
高边换 β = 1000 的管子：还是吸不上
两个都打开：只有低边的 K2 吸合

compare: **对比：高边**：V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ **2.41 V**（仿真 2.41 V）。线圈只拿到 2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ **34 mA**，低于 53 mA 的吸合电流——**K1 不吸合**。剩下的 5V − 2.41 V ≈ **2.26 V** 落在三极管 C–E 上，Q1 在**放大区**，白白耗散 77 mW。
- 把 5V 换成 12V 也没用：发射极仍然只有 2.4 V，只是三极管上的电压和发热更大。
- 换 β = 1000 的管子也没用：基极电流变小、RB 上的压降少了，V_E 只升到 **2.61 V**（37 mA），还是吸不上。限制它的不是放大倍数，而是“发射极永远比基极低 0.65 V”。
- 开着高边时实时诊断会给出警告“K1 线圈电流不够，吸合不了：34 mA”，以及提示“Q1 工作在放大区（没有完全导通）”——这正是这个电路的毛病。

**对比：低边**：V_BE 永远是 0.65 V，基极电流 Ib = (3.23 − 0.70) V / 1 kΩ ≈ **2.5 mA**，β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 线圈需要的 63 mA，三极管**饱和**，Vce 只有 **0.21 V**；线圈上 4.44 V（5V 引脚 4.65 V − 0.21 V），**63 mA**，K2 吸合。引脚只出 2.5 mA，三极管只耗 15 mW。

measurements.ask: 只打开高边：Q1 发射极对 GND 的电压（线圈上拿到的电压）
measurements.explain: 射极跟随器：V_E = 3.29 V − 0.23 mA × 1 kΩ − 0.65 V ≈ 2.41 V。发射极永远比基极低 0.65 V，而基极最高只有 3.3 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：K1 的线圈电流
measurements.explain: 2.41 V / 70 Ω ≈ 34 mA < 53 mA：K1 不吸合。剩下的约 2.3 V 落在 Q1 的 C–E 上，Q1 在放大区，白白发热。

measurements.ask: 只打开低边：Q2 的 Vce
measurements.explain: Ib ≈ 2.5 mA，β·Ib ≈ 380 mA ≫ 63 mA：Q2 饱和，Vce ≈ 0.21 V。

measurements.ask: 同一状态：K2 的线圈电流
measurements.explain: 线圈上 4.65 − 0.21 ≈ 4.44 V，≈ 63 mA，K2 吸合。引脚只出 2.5 mA，三极管只耗 15 mW。

choices: 不能：发射极电压仍被“基极电压 − 0.65 V”限制，只升到约 2.6 V
能：β 大了，线圈电流就大了
能：三极管会进入饱和区
measurements.ask: 高边换一个 β = 1000 的管子（在 Q1 的属性里改 β 试试），K1 能吸合吗？
measurements.explain: Ib 变小、RB 上压降少了，V_E 只升到 ≈ 2.61 V（37 mA）。限制它的不是放大倍数；把 5V 换成 12V 也没用。必须高边时用 P 沟道 MOSFET 加电平转换，或现成的高边开关。

hints: 高边：集电极接 5V，发射极接继电器线圈，线圈另一端接 GND。
低边：线圈从 5V 接到集电极，发射极接 GND。
每个线圈各并一个反向二极管：色环朝线圈电位更高的一端。
两个基极各串一个 1 kΩ，分别接两个不同的输出 GPIO。
